body.x: With the support from Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, GB Soft (CEO Park Gi-beom) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase the world’s first non-contact biosignal measurement system.

This system is totally different from the conventional method of attachment-type biosignal measuring system, free from the trouble of attachment and cross-contamination because it can measure the biosignal only by the camera.

Also, since the users do not need a separate sensor or equipment, it can be used widely in people and areas whom and where it is hard to attach them. It can measure pulse, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and body temperature. Unlike other companies’ products, only camera is used to measure the biosignals, which is a big competitiveness.

The CEO of GB Soft said, “We are currentlydiscussing the joint research with Hyundai Mobis and supply with Lotte E&Cand Daewoo E&C, and we are also discussing with overseas companies. We aimto increase the market share of our products in construction, autonomousdriving and telemedicine."

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196 ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eight consecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4 million as of 2019.

Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, will have 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
